build_lm_transformer_model: build a language model transformer using LMTransformer with LMTransformerArgs for vocab size and layers
create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask for fmha, sdpa, or flex_attention implementations with optional sliding window
calculate_flops_per_token: calculate the number of FLOPs per token given non-embed params, layers, dim, and sequence length
build_fsdp_grouping_plan: build an FSDP grouping plan tuple for model layers and output for fully sharded data parallel training
tp_parallelize_model: parallelize a transformer model across tensor parallel devices using ColwiseParallel and RowwiseParallel strategies
